cto-orchestrator.description: TrueVow CTO Orchestrator — independent QA and architecture gatekeeper. Verifies claims, challenges evidence, audits diffs, gates work orders. Read-only by default.

skill-gate.description: Run the TrueVow skill gate on staged files (security + review, blocks CRITICAL)
skill-gate.template: Run: python TrueVow_Shared_Orchestration/skill-gate.py pre-commit and report the verdict. $ARGUMENTS

skill-watcher.description: Run the always-on TrueVow skill watcher across all service repos
skill-watcher.template: Run: python TrueVow_Shared_Orchestration/skill-watcher.py --once and report findings by invariant. $ARGUMENTS

cto-qa.description: Invoke the CTO Orchestrator to independently verify a work order (read-only audit)
cto-qa.template: Act as the TrueVow CTO Orchestrator per TrueVow_CTO_Knowledge_Orchestrator/CTO-ORCHESTRATOR-QA-MANDATE.md. Independently verify the claim: $ARGUMENTS. Read code, not markdown. Classify evidence. Return QA RESULT: PASS/CONDITIONAL_PASS/FAIL/HOLD.
